artifacts.summary: Verifies all 8 dispatch-listed README defects against source ground truth (Axioms.lean, DerivedAxioms.lean, PlusLanguage/Axioms.lean, harness checks C14/C21/C22), confirms items 5 and part of item 6 already resolved by task 631, and derives the exact arithmetic reconciling the 29-primitive vs 45-total-with-mirrors axiom-count conventions plus recommended fixes per file.

memory_candidates.content: BimodalLogic's axiom system has two legitimate, non-contradictory counts: 29 primitive constructors of `inductive Axiom` (23 Base + 2 Dense + 2 ZTime + 2 RTime, per Axiom.minFrameClass) vs 45 total named schemata (29 primitives + 16 derived theorems in DerivedAxioms.lean, mostly TR past-mirrors) -- confirmed by FormalSystem/Automation/BenchmarkAnchorsMain.lean's own docstring ('29 primitive axioms and 16 derived schemata... 45 names in all'). The README's 37/40/39/42 per-class table figures are the 45-total convention partitioned by minimum frame class, where a derived mirror inherits its primitive's tier (e.g. RTime = 37 base + 2 dense + 3 RTime-tier[prior_U_gap, sep, and derived mirror prior_S_gap] = 42). When auditing or fixing axiom counts in this repo, always state which of the two conventions a number uses -- do not assume a discrepancy is an error without checking whether it's actually the other legitimate convention.

check-module-invariants.sh's C14 stale-axiom-count tripwire only matches the regex `\b(14|21|42|44|45)[[:space:]]+([A-Za-z\xe2\x81\xba+]+[[:space:]]+)?(axiom|constructor|schema)` -- i.e. digit-then-word order -- over docs/**/*.md, README.md, and FormalSystem/**/*.lean (excluding Boneyard/, and lines containing 'covers'). It is blind to table-cell-only numbers ('| **Base** | 37 |'), reversed phrasing ('Dense + 2 axioms = 39'), and any file outside its docs/README.md-or-.lean scope (e.g. FormalSystem/Syntax/PlusLanguage/README.md). A green C14 is not evidence that axiom counts are internally consistent -- cross-check against Axiom.minFrameClass / allAxiomNames directly instead of relying on this check alone.
